tasks.instruction: Make the sequence from S08 to S13 tenser by tightening pacing: shorten each cut where possible to increase tempo, trimming take lengths to 4s for S08, S09, S10, S12, S13 and to 6s for S11 (two-shot) while preserving the intended blocking and line delivery.
Keep S11 at a tighter 6s (instead of 8s) to quicken the exchange between Nimal and Dinu while preserving the two-shot framing.
Reduce S12 and S13 to 6s each to maintain momentum into the near-final beats of the block.
